The web detail href /charging/{id} has no native router in this parity tree, so row/checkbox press is wired to onToggleSelect; documented in the file header.

Units: every energy stays SI Wh (->kWh only at the display boundary via /1000) and every power stays SI W (->kW via /1000); no mi/min/mph/kwh/kw struct or column names were introduced. snake_case query params (vehicle_id) preserved.

No DOM elements, Recharts, Leaflet, framer-motion, lucide-react, or old web UI imported; only React Native primitives (View/Pressable/TextInput/Animated/Easing/AccessibilityInfo/Linking/StyleSheet), shared native components (AppText/GlassPanel via EmptyState/SemanticIcon), the apiUrl client helper, theme tokens, and the three converted parity siblings (StaggerContainer, ActiveFilterChips, BulkActionsToolbar). The only inline styles are the Animated opacity/transform driver values (the RN-allowed dynamic case); all static styling is in StyleSheet.
